_about: Meshy prompts for characters (the hero and enemies), keyed by their tracker ID. batch.py reads
these alongside OBJECTS.md and friends, and still only sends approved IDs.
rig: 'biped' or 'quadruped' (Meshy rigs both). pose: 'a-pose' helps biped rigging.
height_m: rig height. actions: Meshy animation library IDs (GET /openapi/v1/animations/library);
rigging also returns basic walking and running clips for free.
